name: a governing create inserts its tree scope at seq 0 with digest 0
a replayed governing create inserts nothing
a governing delete kills its tree and every overlay of it, and no other
a write to the dead tree is scope-dead for its owner
a governing create onto its dead id is ok without a change
a revive of a dead governing record is id-spent
a new governing id after a death creates a new scope
a command writing into a scope it creates (a copy of an empty tree) leaves the new scope at seq 0 with digest 0
